title: The Godfather Part II
description: Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) rules his father's criminal empire, while flashbacks recall young Vito's (Robert De Niro) climb to power.

title: The Godfather, Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
description: Dignified Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) joins his wild nephew in a Sicilian vendetta involving the Vatican.

title: Beautiful Girls
description: The opposite sex preoccupies working-class pals gathered for their high-school reunion in small-town Massachusetts.

title: No Strings Attached
description: After sex enters the equation, two lifelong friends (Natalie Portman, Ashton Kutcher) make a pact to keep their relationship purely physical.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog
description: The world needed a hero and it got a hedgehog. Powered with incredible speed, Sonic races across the globe to stop uncool evil genius Dr. Robotnik from achieving world domination.

title: Gravity
description: The destruction of their shuttle leaves two astronauts, Dr. Ryan Stone and Matt Kowalski, stranded in space with no hope of rescue.

title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
description: Two cyborgs from the future battle over the life of a teen (Edward Furlong) who will someday lead humanity against the machines.

title: Terminator: Dark Fate
description: Seasoned warrior Sarah Connor joins forces with a hybrid cyborg human and the T-800 model to protect a young woman from the Rev-9 -- a newly modified and seemingly indestructible liquid Terminator from the future.

title: Quantum of Solace
description: James Bond's (Daniel Craig) hunt for those responsible for Vesper Lynd's death leads him to a ruthless businessman (Mathieu Amalric) who is plotting to seize control of a valuable resource.

title: The Hunt for Red October
description: Moscow, Washington and a CIA analyst (Alec Baldwin) track a renegade Soviet captain (Sean Connery) and his new submarine.

title: Patriot Games
description: An IRA terrorist vows revenge against the ex-CIA agent who killed the man's brother and thwarted an attack on royalty.

title: Se7en

description: Hoping to close a sale and save their jobs, two co-workers (Jason Bateman, T.J. Miller) must rally their colleagues to throw an epic Christmas party.

title: Nine
description: An Italian director (Daniel Day-Lewis) endures personal and creative crises as he tries to juggle relationships with his wife (Marion Cotillard), his mistress (Penélope Cruz) and numerous other women.

title: Snoopy, Come Home
description: The "Peanuts" gang becomes upset when the beloved beagle decides to leave home in search of his roots.

title: Rush Hour
description: A Hong Kong detective and a wisecracking L.A.P.D. detective choose to work together to find the missing daughter of a Chinese diplomat.

description: A plastic surgeon (Adam Sandler) enlists the aid of his assistant (Jennifer Aniston) and her children to help him win the heart of a beautiful woman.
